title: HECM Line Held Against Occupancy Inspection Fees
content:
Added to the amounts kept for the draw ceiling of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM): Cedarline keeps in the line for the draw ceiling the occupancy inspection fees a certification lapse will cost. The loan's occupancy certification profile under Occupancy and Residency Certification, and the inspection fee of that profile's plan, decide the inspection reserve.

**Schedule basis.** When the loan's occupancy certification profile is overdue or in absence monitoring and its plan's occupancy inspection fee is above 0.00, the inspection reserve is twice the profile plan's occupancy inspection fee.

**Ledger basis.** When the profile is current and occupancy inspection fees were posted to the loan on a date after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date, the inspection reserve is what the last cycle actually cost, the total of the occupancy inspection fees posted in that window.

**Otherwise** the inspection reserve is 0.00 — for instance a current profile with no inspection fee posted in the window, an overdue profile whose plan fee is 0.00, a profile in any other status, or no profile.

| Profile status | Plan inspection fee | Fees posted in the window | Inspection reserve (hypothetical figures) |
|---|---|---|---|
| overdue | 85.00 | any | 170.00 |
| absence monitoring | 85.00 | any | 170.00 |
| overdue | 0.00 | any | 0.00 |
| current | any | 85.00 and 85.00 | 170.00 |
| current | any | none | 0.00 |

The window runs from the day after the same day of the month twelve calendar months before the handling date: with a handling date of 20 August, a fee posted on 21 August of the previous year counts and one posted on 20 August of the previous year does not.
